rules.when: a worker runs on this runtime
rules.why: Cursor renders no trust dialog for a launch, so the gate is never consulted for it. A plain Enter submits. Its cursor parks outside the composer, so the composer verdict cannot be proven and the rendered busy footer is what acknowledges the submit. One Escape cancels the turn and does not restore the cancelled prompt, so no clear key is needed. A relaunch cannot resume an exact session, so it starts fresh. While a turn runs the pane carries a `ctrl+c to stop` footer; idle it does not. A turn is read from its bound conversation transcript, never from that footer.
